title: RepoMesh AgentTeams Task Package v2 Meta (publish time)
description: meta.json as the platform publishes it. The native fields are copaw's task record; task_id is the attempt id, not the RepoMesh task id (D-6, D-8). The repomesh object is valid ONLY at publish time: copaw rewrites meta.json from its own TaskMeta on ack_task and submit_task and drops the object, and the background push never brings it back (spike S-3). Consumers must not depend on it — the observer claims attempts by directory name and reads base/package.json for control data. This schema describes the file the platform writes, not the file copaw later rewrites.

task_id.description: The attempt id; equals the directory name.

assigned_to.description: The assignee's AgentTeams resource name (Matrix localpart): the Worker for a construction package, the Team Leader for a review package.

room_id.description: The team room for a construction package; the Leader's own room for a review package (D-3).

repomesh.description: Publish-time snapshot for humans and for the publisher's own conflict check. Gone after the assignee acks. Never read it back.

task_id.description: The RepoMesh task id this attempt belongs to.

review_of.description: Review packages only: the construction attempt under review.

package.description: Where the control data actually lives.
